_: The sources: what a people draws its means from, natural and left. The numbers (yields, what harnesses them) are the history's tables; this file names them. In a name, {T} is the source's star, {F} the feature it is the reach of, {L} the remain it is.

sources: one row per kind of source: key; name (how a line says it); kind (world, belt, giant, cosmic, elder, made); frame (what a rarity is called in a gazetteer note); harness marks a kind whose first harnessing is a deed, remark a rarity whose first holding is remarked; desc.
Every term here is a technical term: a phrase a reader who never saw this project understands or can search for, never a coinage.
